2609.27387.title: AraGenre 2026: A Hierarchical Definition-Guided Arabic Genre Classification Shared Task
2609.27387.paper_summary: AraGenre is a shared task on hierarchical, definition-guided Arabic genre classification, motivated by the limited availability of annotated data in Arabic and other low-resource languages. Systems assign each Arabic text segment both a broad communicative genre and a fine-grained specific genre. The released training and development sets contain limited, primarily synthetic and controlled examples, whereas the hidden final benchmark contains noisier naturally occurring text spanning Modern Standard Arabic, Classical Arabic, and multiple dialects. Participants received natural-language definitions for 74 previously unseen specific genres, creating a zero-shot label generalisation setting in which systems had to infer class semantics rather than memorise fixed label-feature associations. The task attracted 46 registrations and 373 submissions, with 17 teams completing the final evaluation. Thakaa ranked first with a Hierarchical Macro F1 of 0.7352, followed by HoangPhong (HP) with 0.7169 and NAMAA with 0.7013. The results show strong broad-genre recognition but a substantial gap in fine-grained classification under linguistic and domain variation.
2609.27387.paper_summary_zh: AraGenre 是一個關於分層、定義指導的阿拉伯文類型分類的共享任務，旨在解決阿拉伯語及其他低資源語言中標註數據有限的問題。系統為每個阿拉伯文本片段分配一個廣泛的傳達類型和一個細緻的特定類型。發布的訓練和開發集包含有限的、主要是合成和受控的範例，而隱藏的最終基準則包含噪音較多的自然文本，涵蓋現代標準阿拉伯語、古典阿拉伯語和多種方言。參與者獲得了74個先前未見的特定類型的自然語言定義，創造了一個零樣本標籤泛化的環境，系統必須推斷類別語義，而不是記憶固定的標籤-特徵關聯。該任務吸引了46個報名和373個提交，17個團隊完成了最終評估。Thakaa 以 0.7352 的分層宏 F1 排名第一，其次是 HoangPhong (HP) 的 0.7169 和 NAMAA 的 0.7013。結果顯示出強大的廣泛類型識別能力，但在語言和領域變化下的細緻分類存在顯著差距。
